# Northwind Telecom — Home fibre broadband

*Synthetic document. Northwind Telecom is a fictional operator invented for testing; every figure
below is made up and describes no real product, tariff or person.*

## Availability

Fibre is sold only where a serviceable fibre node is within 300 metres of the premises. Serviceability
is checked against the installation address, not the billing address, and is confirmed before any
payment is taken.

## The plans

| Plan | Monthly rent | Speed | Monthly data | Included |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Fibre Basic | ₹599 | 50 Mbps | 1,000 GB | router on loan |
| Fibre Plus | ₹899 | 200 Mbps | 2,000 GB | router on loan, landline |
| Fibre Max | ₹1,399 | 500 Mbps | 4,000 GB | router on loan, landline, mesh node |
| Fibre Ultra | ₹2,499 | 1 Gbps | unmetered | router on loan, landline, 2 mesh nodes |

Speeds are the maximum the line is provisioned for and are measured at the router's LAN port, not
over Wi-Fi.

## Installation

Installation is scheduled within 72 hours of a successful serviceability check. The installation
charge is ₹1,500 and is waived on any annual prepayment. A missed appointment is rescheduled free of
charge once; a second miss attracts a ₹250 visit fee.

## The router

The router is lent, not sold. It stays the property of Northwind Telecom and must be returned within
15 days of closing the connection. A router that is not returned is billed at ₹2,800. Mesh nodes are
lent on the same terms and are billed at ₹1,900 each if not returned.

## Static IP

A static IPv4 address is available on Fibre Plus and above for ₹300 a month. It is provisioned within
one working day of the request and is released when the connection closes.

## Suspension while away

A connection can be suspended for a minimum of 30 and a maximum of 90 days in a calendar year, at
₹99 a month. Suspension must be requested at least 48 hours before it starts.
